text:
Eli: BlueHarbor reached out - they want a marketplace-ready refarch and Terraform modules for their optimized images. Requirements: ARM64 + GPU variants, simple multi-AZ example, minimal IAM, and a 1-page ops runbook. Deadline: 2 weeks. Anyone take lead?
Priya: I can lead the module. Plan: a single module with `hardware_profile` var: `graviton` | `ampere_gpu` and outputs for SKUs. Will scaffold today.
Marcus: Reuse our `ref-llm-deploy` conventions but add `enable_failover = true` and add a small example showing `route53` weighted routing.
Priya: Example snippet I'll add: ```terraform
module "blueharbor_marketplace" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-stencils/blueharbor"
  hardware_profile = var.hardware_profile # graviton | ampere_gpu
  regions = ["us-east-1", "us-west-2"]
}
```
Tess: Packaging note - we need partner-signed manifest, SBOM, and an instructions section on verifying image signatures during deploy. BlueHarbor will supply signed images per their email.
Eli: Also they asked for a short "Redwood Verified" performance blurb using non-prod numbers. Use our perf doc link and add a note that metrics are lab numbers.
Marcus: CI: add `ci/marketplace-smoke.yml` GH action that builds SBOM, deploys to ephemeral acct, runs `scripts/verify.sh --sample-requests 10`, then tears down. I'll draft the workflow.
catalog-bot: Created ticket P-3667: "BlueHarbor marketplace refarch + terraform module" assigned to @Priya
Priya: I'll open the initial PR with module skeleton tomorrow. Can someone add a tiny `examples/minimal-client` (curl + python) and a prompt set for sanity/regression checks?
Tess: I'll add `examples/minimal-client` and a short ops README: healthchecks, key rotation notes, and rollback steps.
Eli: Great. Sync Friday 11am PT to review PR and perf blurb. :thumbsup:
